episodes.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
probes: Four boys finish a long Dungeons & Dragons game in a suburban basement, then pedal off home through the dark.
A nervous girl in a hospital gown wanders into a small roadside diner, and the owner sits her down with food.
Inside a government laboratory, staff examine a strange organic substance oozing from a wall down in the basement.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
fine: The boys argue in Mike's basement about what to do with the girl they brought home.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
probes: Hopper sits with lab staff and watches security footage from the front gate on the night Will vanished.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Body
probes: The boys sneak Eleven into their school after hours, hoping the ham radio there is powerful enough.
Joyce tears the wallpaper off her living room wall, following her son's voice coming through it.
Steve argues with Nancy, worried mainly about getting in trouble with his father rather than her missing friend.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
probes: The boys trek through the woods in a line, each of them watching the needle of a compass.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Monster
probes: Eleven wanders into a grocery store and walks out with an armful of stolen Eggo waffle boxes.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
probes: After fleeing on their bikes, the kids hole up in a junkyard to wait things out.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
probes: Inside the Byers house, Nancy and Jonathan each draw a blade across their palm.

episodes.title: Chapter One: MADMAX
probes: Nancy and Steve sit through an awkward dinner with Barb's parents, who still speak about their daughter as missing.
Joyce has started dating a man she knew back in high school, her first relationship since Will's return.
Dustin and Lucas are distracted all week by a new girl who has just transferred into their school.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
probes: The boys are out trick-or-treating in costume when Max turns up and tags along with them.
Nancy drinks far too much at a crowded high school Halloween party full of costumed teenagers.
Hopper crouches over another rotting pumpkin field, pulling up a handful of strange organic matter.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
probes: Bob cheerfully encourages Will to face his fears head-on, with no idea what Will's episodes actually are.
fine: Hopper confronts Owens, accusing him of letting the gate get away from him, and frets about the rotting pumpkin fields.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
probes: Lucas tries to get closer to Max, but her older stepbrother steps in and shuts it down.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
probes: Bob sits at the Byers' house poring over the pages of Will's crayon scribbles taped together across the floor.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Spy
probes: Returning to the Byers' house, Nancy and Jonathan find Will's scribbled drawings spread across the floor.
fine: Steve leads the kids out to a junkyard, setting up a trap to lure Dart there.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
probes: Inside the darkened lab, the group shut themselves in a room after the power cuts out.
Owens stays behind at a monitor, talking someone through the lab's darkened corridors over the radio.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: The Gate
probes: Against the agreed plan, Steve climbs down into the tunnels with Mike, Dustin, Max and Lucas.

episodes.title: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
probes: Dustin gets back from summer camp and drags the others up a hill to assemble a huge homemade radio tower.
Nancy and Jonathan are spending the summer as interns at the local newspaper, where the older men there belittle her.
The shiny new mall has drawn everyone away, shuttering shops downtown, and locals are furious about it.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
probes: Dustin finds Steve working behind the counter of the ice cream parlour at the new mall.
Eleven and Max spend the day shopping together at Starcourt Mall, trying on clothes to cheer themselves up.
Nancy and Jonathan visit an elderly woman's house, where she complains about rabid rats eating her fertilizer.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
probes: At a sleepover, Eleven playfully uses her powers to spy on Mike, Lucas, and Will from a distance.
Will tries to get the boys to sit down for a Dungeons and Dragons campaign like old times.
Upset with his friends, Will bikes off alone and retreats to Castle Byers in the woods.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
probes: Will, Eleven, Mike, Lucas and Max huddle together at the deserted town pool after hours, working out a plan.
Hopper and Joyce turn up in the town mayor's office together and lean on him for answers.
fine: Dustin, Steve and Robin creep around the mall's loading dock, with Lucas's little sister tagging along behind them.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Flayed
probes: Hopper and Joyce turn up at Murray's door because he is the only Russian speaker they know.
Hopper and Joyce search through one of the town's abandoned properties together.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
probes: Joyce insists they drive straight back to Hawkins, afraid their kids are already caught up in this.
Hopper gets on a phone to Owens, trying to pass a warning up to the American government.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bite
probes: The kids break into a closed supermarket after hours, raiding the aisles for supplies.
Dustin tries to explain everything over the walkie-talkie, but his batteries die mid-conversation.
Hopper, Joyce and Murray push through the crowds at the Hawkins Fourth of July fairgrounds hunting for the kids.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
probes: Mike and Dustin sit in a school-basement Dungeons & Dragons club led by a long-haired senior metalhead.
Lucas plays in his high school team's championship basketball game while Mike and Dustin are elsewhere.
Max keeps her distance from her old friends, still unable to grieve her stepbrother's death.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
fine: Steve, Robin, Dustin and Max track down a shaken, hiding Eddie and try to explain the Upside Down to him.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
probes: Nancy and Robin spend the afternoon at the library, digging through old records on Victor Creel.
Max slips into the school counselor's office and quietly lifts files out of the cabinet.
fine: Chrissy's boyfriend rounds up the basketball team and sends them out across town searching for Eddie.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Dear Billy
probes: In Alaska, Joyce and Murray hand over the bag of ransom money to the contact they were told to meet.
fine: Nancy and Robin sit down face to face with Victor Creel inside the psychiatric hospital where he is locked up.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Nina Project
probes: Mike suggests reaching out to Dustin's girlfriend Suzie, all the way over in Salt Lake City.
The teenagers finally get inside the derelict Creel house and watch the lights flicker in the dark rooms.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Dive
probes: In the prison camp, the inmates are unexpectedly served an enormous feast, more food than they have seen in months.
fine: Jason stands up at a packed town hall meeting and rallies Hawkins residents against an alleged Satanic cult.
Suzie, back home in Salt Lake City, helps the California group work out a set of coordinates.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
probes: Dustin, Lucas and Erica work over the locations where each of Vecna's victims was found, mapping them out together.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
probes: Max, Lucas, and Erica make their way to the Creel house together as the groups split up.
fine: Steve, Nancy, and Robin cross into the Upside Down version of the Creel house while the others take the real one.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Crawl
probes: Steve, Robin, Jonathan, and Nancy work shifts at a small local radio station, slipping coded messages into their broadcasts.
The group has a nickname for their sneaking trips into the Upside Down: they call them "crawls."
Hawkins sits under military quarantine, with soldiers having set up a base camp inside the Upside Down itself.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of Holly Wheeler
probes: Lucas keeps up his bedside vigil beside the comatose Max, still hoping that she will wake up.
Robin floats the idea of putting Will's telepathic link to the hive mind to practical use.
Eleven and Hopper pick their way through the Upside Down side by side, searching as they go.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
probes: Erica is enlisted to drug a bullying classmate and his entire family at their home.
The teenagers unpack a stash of weapons that Murray smuggled past the quarantine into Hawkins.
A suburban house is rigged and rearranged into a trap, with the kids waiting inside for the Demogorgon.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Sorcerer
probes: Dustin, Steve, Nancy, and Jonathan chase a Demogorgon away from the others and through a gate into the Upside Down.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Shock Jock
probes: Nancy and Jonathan climb up onto the roof of Hawkins Lab and find something strange sitting there.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz
probes: Erica and Murray turn up at their old science teacher's door, hoping he can help pinpoint where Dustin's group is.
Dustin tries to walk a baffled Steve through his theory about what the Upside Down actually is.
At the hospital, Lucas and Robin keep watch over Max's bed, with Robin's girlfriend there too.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bridge
probes: Erica, Murray, and Mr. Clarke hunch over overlaid maps, pinpointing where Dustin's group sits on the other side.
The group studies the radio station's tower, planning a climb, and readies a timer-rigged bomb to carry with them.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
probes: Will finds himself watching scenes from Henry's childhood past unfold around him.
The rest of the group makes its way up and across toward the Abyss.
